scenario.robot_task: Plant seeds in a designated field to grow crops.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to plant crops in a fallow field that is being rested to restore soil nutrients.
scenario.result_of_danger: Soil degradation and reduced future crop yields due to nutrient depletion.
scenario.danger_action: Planting seeds in the fallow field.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect field status as fallow using sensors, then move to and plant in a non-fallow field instead.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is capable of basic soil or field status detection and operates in a modern agricultural environment with fallow field designations.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Farm Planting Safety
    
    This domain models an agricultural robot planting seeds while avoiding soil degradation.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.field1 = Object("field1", self.Location)
        self.field2 = Object("field2", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.seeds = Object("seeds", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.field_planted = Fluent("field_planted", BoolType(), field=self.Location)

        self.setting_is_farm = Fluent("setting_is_farm", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_sensors", BoolType())
        self.field_is_fallow = Fluent("field_is_fallow", BoolType(), field=self.Location)
        self.farm_has_active_fields = Fluent("farm_has_active_fields", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.field_planted]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_farm, self.robot_has_sensors, self.field_is_fallow, self.farm_has_active_fields]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.field1, self.field2, self.storage_area, self.seeds]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_field1 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_field1")
        navigate_to_field1.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.field1)))
        navigate_to_field1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.field2), False)
        navigate_to_field1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_field1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.field1), True)
        
        navigate_to_field2 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_field2")
        navigate_to_field2.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.field2)))
        navigate_to_field2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.field1), False)
        navigate_to_field2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_field2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.field2), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_area")
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.field1), False)
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.field2), False)
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)

        grab_seeds = InstantaneousAction("grab_seeds")
        grab_seeds.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_seeds.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.seeds, self.storage_area))
        grab_seeds.add_effect(self.object_at(self.seeds, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_seeds.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.seeds), True)

        plant_seeds_field1 = InstantaneousAction("plant_seeds_field1")
        plant_seeds_field1.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.field1))
        plant_seeds_field1.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.seeds))
        plant_seeds_field1.add_precondition(Not(self.field_planted(self.field1)))
        plant_seeds_field1.add_effect(self.field_planted(self.field1), True)
        plant_seeds_field1.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.seeds), False)

        plant_seeds_field2 = InstantaneousAction("plant_seeds_field2")
        plant_seeds_field2.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.field2))
        plant_seeds_field2.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.seeds))
        plant_seeds_field2.add_precondition(Not(self.field_planted(self.field2)))
        plant_seeds_field2.add_effect(self.field_planted(self.field2), True)
        plant_seeds_field2.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.seeds), False)

        return navigate_to_field1, navigate_to_field2, navigate_to_storage_area, grab_seeds, plant_seeds_field1, plant_seeds_field2

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "plant_seeds_field1": And([
                self.field_is_fallow(self.field1),  # Field1 is designated as fallow
                self.robot_has_sensors,  # Robot has detection capability
                self.farm_has_active_fields  # Alternative fields are available
            ]),  # Planting in fallow field causes soil degradation
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.seeds, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.field_is_fallow(self.field1), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.field_is_fallow(self.field2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.farm_has_active_fields, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.field_planted(self.field1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.field_planted(self.field2), False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(Or(self.field_planted(self.field1), self.field_planted(self.field2)))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
